title: Electrical and Electronics Engineer
desc:
Kastamonu Entegre Ağaç Sanayi which is one of the two locomotive companies of Hayat Holding was established in year 1969 for production in the wooden panel industry and today became a global power which is the 1st in Türkiye, the 3rd in Europe and the 4th in the world in its field.
Kastamonu Entegre Headquarters is looking for a
“Electrical and Electronics Engineer"
in Global Tecnology Directorate. The position is based in Altunizade, İstanbul.
Job Role Details
Lead the design and development of
embedded&acoustic
electronic systems, from concept to production, with a focus on high-performance processors and microcontrollers
Develop and maintain schematics and multilayer PCB layouts using Altium Designer, ensuring signal integrity for high-speed and differential pair routing
Provide technical support to
R&D on acoustic/sound insulation of equipment
, contributing
acoustic modeling
and simulation expertise related to
sound and wave behavior
Conduct feasibility studies, prototyping, and proof-of-concept designs for new product requests
Perform hardware validation and debugging, using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers to identify and resolve design issues
Collaborate closely with software, mechanical, and system teams to deliver optimized embedded solutions
Write, test, and debug embedded firmware in C/C++, ensuring robust and reliable functionality
Document design specifications, validation procedures, and test reports for internal and external stakeholders
Support production teams during the industrialization and mass production phases, addressing design issues and ensuring manufacturability
Skills
Bachelor's degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Control & Automation Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline specializing in electronic systems, embedded software, and industrial automation
Experience in PCB design using (Altium/KiCad) and embedded systems (STM32/ESP32, RTOS/bare-metal)
Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols (GigE Vision, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET) as well as 10GbE network infrastructure
Proficiency in C/C++ and Python for camera SDK integration and device driver development
Hands-on experience with field operations, system commissioning, and production line integration
Strong communication, solid problem solving skills and result oriented approach
Fluency in English, both written and spoken
No restriction to travel
Military service must be completed for male candidates
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with FPGA (VHDL/Verilog)
Experience in PLC programming (Siemens TIA Portal)
Experience with Real-Time Linux (RT-Preempt)
Background in acoustics, acoustic modeling/simulation, or wave propagation
Experience
3–6 years of professional experience in a similar role
Thank you for taking the time to review our job advertisement. If you think it is a match to your knowledge and interests, please apply. We are eager to learn more about you!
